results.title: UK's Royal Navy and RAF branded 'terrorist': Iran's fresh move also targets MI6
results.description: In a major development in the Middle East conflict, Iran has escalated tensions with the UK by designating Britain's Royal Navy and Royal Air Force as terrorist organisations.

results.title: YSRCP Alleges Discrepancy in Pulivendula Voting Data and Procedures
results.description: YSRCP alleges voting data discrepancies and widespread electoral irregularities, including voter intimidation and booth capturing by TDP workers, during the municipal polling process in Pulivendula, Andhra Pradesh.

results.title: BJP MLA Claims Moon Belongs To Sanatan Dharma Ignites New Controversy
results.description: BJP MLA Rameshwar Sharma sparks controversy by claiming the moon belongs to Sanatan Dharma, drawing sharp criticism from Muslim leader Abbas Hafeez who dismissed the remarks as nonsensical and unbecoming of a political representative.

results.title: INDIA Bloc Leaders Demand CEC Resignation Over Alleged Electoral Errors
results.description: Opposition leaders at a massive Delhi rally demanded the resignation of CEC Gyanesh Kumar, citing electoral roll irregularities, with Kapil Sibal calling the gathering the beginning of the end for the ruling BJP government at the Centre.

results.title: Rahul Gandhi Targets BJP Over Closed Shops As Opposition Leaders Head To Ramlila Maidan - VIDEO
results.description: Referring to his appeal a day earlier asking rally participants to shop from local businesses, Rahul Gandhi said they had encouraged people attending the march and rally to support traders.

results.title: Illinois residents encouraged to search for unclaimed funds
results.description: Illinois residents can search ICash online to determine whether unclaimed property belongs to them or their families.
